Game Overview

In Merge Plants and Zombies, the core idea is straightforward: strategically merge and upgrade your army of plants and zombies in this addictive arcade game. Balance melee and ranged units, tactically combining them for enhanced power. Use fast-paced matches, drag-and-drop controls, and clever planning to outlast enemies and secure victory in engaging battles.
